The '''Volcanic Trench''' was a section of the [[Glacial Fissure]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] notable for the geothermal vents that lined its floor. The [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] controlled the Trench as they did much of the region.
